verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automation or workflow engine that runs autonomously in the background. Scheduled check-ins (docs-8) are a fixed recurring prompt feature, not general automations. Inviting external AI agents, MCP support, and the REST API are building blocks for automations built elsewhere, not the product's own automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
